recipe: Use `keyof T` on an object type to get the union of its keys as literal types, e.g. `keyof { a: 1; b: 2 }` is `'a' | 'b'`.
trigger_condition: You need a type that is the union of an object type's keys.
evidence: Your goal is to update `CookieSurveyInput` so that it will return a union of all of the names of the various different cookies.
source_name: TypeHero: Advent of TypeScript 2023, Day Two
_original_recipe: When a type needs to represent all possible values of a set of keys (e.g., cookie names), use TypeScript's `keyof` operator on the object type to produce a string literal union.
_review_reason: strip challenge specifics (cookie names); keep the general keyof technique
